name: Facility opening cost
citation_or_basis: Bernardi et al. 2022; Avramescu et al. 2023 (scaled by automation class k1<k2<k3)

name: Capacity contracting cost
citation_or_basis: Avramescu et al. 2023

name: Primary batch mfg cost
citation_or_basis: Avramescu et al. 2023; Bernardi et al. 2022 (decreasing with automation)

name: Max capacity per facility (real)
citation_or_basis: Wan et al. 2026 (Maxcap_j). Base case_study.py uses 40 as an assumption to force two-facility coverage.

name: Per-facility yield success
citation_or_basis: UK National CAR-T Panel (Dulobdas et al. 2025); Locke 2022 / Schuster 2019 / Abramson 2020; within Lopes 2020 / Costariol 2021 10/5/3% band

name: Re-collection eligibility
citation_or_basis: Roth et al. 2018; CARTITUDE-4 (San-Miguel et al. 2023); Bachy et al. 2022 (H/M/L ordering)

name: Cancellation loss
citation_or_basis: Health-economics value-of-life range $1-8M for curative oncology (ICER; Lin et al.); no per-tier trial data

name: Urgency tier mix (H/M/L)
citation_or_basis: Kymriah DLBCL indication epidemiology; Avramescu et al. 2021b conditional r/r probabilities

name: Leukapheresis cost
citation_or_basis: Published leukapheresis procedure cost

name: Re-manufacture cost
citation_or_basis: Set equal to primary batch cost; no published re-mfg-specific breakdown

name: Subcontracting cost
citation_or_basis: 15% premium on destination primary cost; no public CAR-T CMO contract data

name: Transport time (60 pairs)
citation_or_basis: Haversine great-circle from Wan et al. 2026 lat/lon; 600 km/h effective air-freight + 6h handling overhead. Deterministic, computed per (hospital,facility) pair.

name: Product shelf life
citation_or_basis: Cryopreservation shelf life; Wan et al. 2026; Avramescu et al. 2023

name: Max open facilities
citation_or_basis: Industry dual/triple-sourcing of autologous CDMOs

name: Re-manufacture delay anchor
citation_or_basis: Cohet 2023 real-world OOS cohort: vein-to-vein 57.6 vs 45.9 d (delta ~12 d)

name: Delayed-vs-control PFS hazard ratio
citation_or_basis: UK National CAR-T Panel (Dulobdas et al. 2025): delayed-infused vs controls-infused PFS HR 1.64 (P=0.25)

name: Tier delay hazard ratios (H/M/L)
citation_or_basis: Ordered within the observed 1.4-1.6 delay-HR band (Dulobdas 2025 OOS HR 1.41 / delayed HR 1.64; Cohet 2023). Spread is a sensitivity-tested assumption.

name: Weibull scale by shape
citation_or_basis: Solved so mid-tier decline over the +12 d delay reproduces PFS HR 1.64 (Cohet 2023 + Dulobdas 2025)

name: Decline-curve shape
citation_or_basis: Not identified from two endpoints; SWEPT, not fitted

name: Calibrated decline speed
citation_or_basis: Matches the Dulobdas 2025 PFS HR 1.64 at the Cohet 2023 delay; kappa=0 nests the base model

name: Baseline re-mfg processing time
citation_or_basis: ~7 d production + ~7 d QC + 1-2 d transport (Avramescu et al. 2022/2023)

name: Utilization breakpoints
citation_or_basis: Convex PWL clearing-function form (Karmarkar 1989; Missbauer & Uzsoy 2011); no public CDMO congestion data

name: Incremental delay slopes
citation_or_basis: Convex; tuned so rho=1 roughly doubles turnaround. Sweepable.

name: 6-week wait mortality (H/M/L)
citation_or_basis: Order-of-magnitude progression risk during the standard manufacturing wait; basis: reduced vein-to-vein time improves 3L+ LBCL outcomes (Jo/Kwong vein-to-vein study); real-world pre-infusion drop-out. Swept x0.5-x2.0 in E5.

name: Base cohort size
citation_or_basis: Tiling of the 50-patient cohort preserving tier mix and geography (scaled_instance.py). Base n=50 from IICC-3 pediatric ALL incidence (Steliarova-Foucher 2017) refined by Avramescu 2021b r/r conditional probabilities.

name: Training / OOS scenarios
citation_or_basis: Convergence-checked; seeds train 0, OOS 100. Yields Bernoulli(p_m); eligibility Bernoulli(beta_u).

name: Geographic network
citation_or_basis: Wan et al. 2026 (Newark/Boston/Raleigh-Durham/SF; 15 highest-demand hospitals), adapted from Avramescu et al. 2021b

name: Rule family (FIFO, Threshold-X)
citation_or_basis: Prioritization framework of Tseng et al. 2024 (SimPAC): survival-rate-based ordering of scarce slots; extended here to manufacturing failure, re-manufacture recourse, and network design

name: Survival-rate eligibility cutoff
citation_or_basis: Tseng et al. 2024 eligibility threshold; sensitivity-testable
